title: Untitled (Glasses and Planes)
description: Mixed-media collage on white ground incorporating painted eyeglasses motifs in green and red, a side-profile warplane silhouette, compact discs, gold foil fragments, and scattered paper ephemera including currency-like strips. Loosely arranged elements span the picture plane with ink marks, heart outline, and hat imagery distributed across layered paper.
composition: scattered layered elements across white ground
